| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | No (follows Elsevier publisher default) |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | No — disclosure-based for text; image generation prohibited |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | Follows Elsevier generative AI policies: authors must declare AI use in manuscript preparation (statement before references). ## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Elsevier publisher pages and domain knowledge of design research editorial culture (DRS — Design Research Society). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium-High — design tradition more pluralist |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — inclusive design, design for diverse populations |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Design research — design thinking, design cognition, design methodology, engineering design, design education, design epistemology, protocol analysis of designers |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **design research contribution** — DRS-affiliated. Focus on design process, design cognition, design methodology, not just design outputs.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure HCI redirected to TOCHI / HCI journal; pure engineering design redirected to engineering venues.

| Quantitative experimental | 4 | Common — protocol analysis, experimental design studies |
| Qualitative interviews | 4 | Welcomed in design research |
| Autoethnography | 3 | Design-research-through-practice tradition accepted |
| Theoretical / Conceptual | 4 | Design theory welcomed |
| Mixed methods | 5 | Common pattern |
| Meta-analysis | 3 | Welcomed |
| Protocol analysis | 5 | Distinctive Design Studies strength |
| Research-through-design | 4 | Welcomed |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure design outputs without research contribution
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy
- Pure HCI without design-research framing

### Soft Tax

Low for design research tradition authors.

### Best Suited For

- Design cognition empirical research
- Design methodology studies
- Design thinking research
- Engineering design process studies
- Design education research
- Protocol analysis of designers
- Research-through-design

### Not Recommended For

- Pure HCI usability (consider TOCHI, HCI journal)
- Pure engineering design without research lens
- Pure architecture without research lens

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Design Issues](./design-issues.md) | MIT Press peer; design history and theory |
| 2 | [International Journal of Design](../hci/international-journal-of-design.md) | OA design research peer |
| 3 | [ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction](./acm-transactions-on-computer-human-interaction.md) | If HCI angle dominates |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from TOCHI as "too design-process-focused," Design Studies is the Elsevier DRS-affiliated home for design research.
